# OpenX Studio

> OpenX Studio is a client-side, in-browser scenario player, visual editor, and 3D simulator for ASAM OpenSCENARIO (.xosc) and ASAM OpenDRIVE (.xodr) automotive standards. Powered by esmini WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, Three.js, and React.

## Overview

OpenX Studio provides automotive engineers, ADAS/AV researchers, and simulation specialists with a zero-install, high-performance web platform to author, inspect, validate, and simulate OpenSCENARIO and OpenDRIVE files directly in the browser with 60+ FPS 3D rendering.

Website: https://pratiksinghlad.github.io/openx-studio/

## Core Features & Capabilities

- **In-Browser Scenario Simulation**: Real-time OpenSCENARIO execution running on the C++ esmini simulation engine compiled to WebAssembly (WASM).
- **Dual File Dropzone & Validation**: Drag & drop or upload `.xosc` and `.xodr` files with instant XML schema validation, root tag inspection, and syntax error detection.
- **Built-in Demo Scenarios**: Instant one-click presets for common maneuvers (Cut-in, Lane Change, Following, Junction Crossing).
- **Off-Main-Thread Execution**: Simulation stepping and 3D road mesh generation run inside a dedicated Web Worker to maintain smooth 60+ FPS UI responsiveness.
- **Interactive 3D Viewport**: Hardware-accelerated Three.js renderer featuring:
  - Orbit Camera (free rotate, pan, zoom)
  - Follow Camera (chase perspective tracking the ego vehicle)
  - Top-Down / Bird's-Eye Camera (2D/3D map overview)
  - Visual grid, road geometry, dynamic vehicles, and lane markings.
- **Full Playback & Timeline Controls**:
  - Play, Pause, Stop, Seek/Scrub timeline slider.
  - Forward step and instant backward step with internal frame-state caching.
  - Variable speed playback (0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x, 4x).
- **Scenario & Entity Inspector**:
  - Live list of simulated vehicles, pedestrians, and static objects.
  - Real-time telemetry (speed in km/h & m/s, world position X/Y/Z, heading, wheel angles).
  - OpenSCENARIO parameter declarations, storyboards, and road network metadata.
- **Dark / Light / System Theme Support**: Adaptive, accessible modern UI built with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI.

## Supported Standards & Specifications

- **ASAM OpenSCENARIO® (v1.0, v1.1, v1.2)**: Open standard for describing the dynamic content of autonomous vehicle driving scenarios.
- **ASAM OpenDRIVE® (v1.4, v1.5, v1.6, v1.7)**: Open standard for describing static road network geometry, lanes, and junctions.
- **esmini Runtime Engine**: Environment Simulator Minimalistic (MPL-2.0 license).

## Architecture & Technology

- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Radix UI primitives.
- **3D Graphics**: Three.js (WebGL renderer with custom shaders, meshes, line geometries, and shadows).
- **Simulation Runtime**: esmini compiled to WebAssembly via Emscripten.
- **Concurrency**: Web Worker RPC with structured message passing (`postMessage`, `Transferable` buffers).
- **Build Tooling**: Vite 6, TypeScript 5.

## How to Use

1. **Open the Studio**: Visit https://pratiksinghlad.github.io/openx-studio/ in any modern WebGL-compatible browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave).
2. **Load a Scenario**:
   - Drag & drop an OpenSCENARIO XML file (`.xosc`) and OpenDRIVE road network file (`.xodr`) into the dropzone.
   - Or click **Load Example Demo** to simulate a preloaded scenario immediately.
3. **Control Playback**:
   - Use the bottom floating dock to play, pause, step, or adjust playback speed.
   - Click and drag the timeline bar to scrub through scenario time.
4. **Inspect Entities**:
   - Click the **Inspector** button or click on any vehicle in the 3D viewport to inspect live speed, coordinates, and road parameters.
5. **Switch Views**:
   - Use the camera selector to toggle between Orbit, Follow Ego, and Top-Down perspectives.
